name: vsplit
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::vsplit.int(Tensor(a -> *) self, int sections) -> Tensor(a)[]. The correctness suite also covers aten::vsplit.array(Tensor(a -> *) self, int[] indices) -> Tensor(a)[]. vsplit requires rank two or greater and partitions dimension 0, returning a tuple of views whose length, per-part value, shape, dtype, stride, storage offset, view state, shared input storage, and write-through behavior are checked through both the public flag_gems API and the torch dispatcher. Coverage includes evenly divisible integer sections, explicit ascending, repeated, descending, and out-of-range indices, empty and overlapping slices, two- through four-dimensional tensors, floating and integer dtypes including int8 boundary values, noncontiguous input, and distinct nonuniform per-output backward gradients. Integer sections must evenly divide dimension 0; nonpositive counts, non-divisible dimensions, and inputs below rank two are rejected. The operation does not mutate self, while every tensor element of the logical parts list aliases self; Protocol v6.0 effects cannot represent aliases for individual elements of a tensor-list output.
